# Visual & UX Requirements Quality Checklist: Visualización 2.5D del Terreno e Interacciones Expresivas de los Habitantes

**Purpose**: Validate completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of 2.5D terrain projection, expressive deme tokens, direct deme-to-deme interaction arcs, and map camera navigation requirements.
**Created**: 2026-11-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [data-model.md](../data-model.md) | [visual-map.contract.md](../contracts/visual-map.contract.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the 2.5D topographic relief projection and biome visual motifs explicitly specified for all 7 biome types (`tropical_forest`, `savanna`, `arid_steppe`, `tundra`, `high_mountain`, `coastal_shallows`, `ocean`)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-002]
- [x] CHK002 Are both integrated ecological overlays (resource abundance relative to $K_{\max}$ and habitat degradation contour) specified for terrestrial hex cells in the primary map view? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK003 Are the visual token components for every `Deme` (vital status ring, dominant decision archetype badge across all 8 archetypes, and cultural tradition indicator) explicitly defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, §FR-005]
- [x] CHK004 Are interactive map camera controls (`Zoom In`, `Zoom Out`, `Reset View`, and pan gestures) and their coexistence with brush painting explicitly specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Is the ecological degradation threshold ($K < 0.85 \cdot K_{\max}$) for displaying the integrated habitat stress indicator unambiguously quantified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Contract §2.3]
- [x] CHK006 Are the deterministic energy thresholds for the 4 vital status ring states (`thriving`, `stable`, `struggling`, `starving`) explicitly defined? [Clarity, Data-Model §2]
- [x] CHK007 Are the target deme resolution rules for intra-hex disputes, intra/inter-hex symbiotic exchanges, and migratory fission unambiguously specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, Data-Model §1, Contract §1]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK008 Are the `DemeVitalStatus` categories and color semantics consistent between `HexMapCanvas`, `ContextPanel`, and `MapLegend`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, §FR-007, Data-Model §2]
- [x] CHK009 Does the optional `targetDemeId` extension in `HexEdgeFlowSchema` maintain full backward compatibility with persisted/exported `WorldState` JSON payloads? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases, Data-Model §1]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK010 Are layout separation and non-overlapping arc curvature requirements defined when up to 3 demes cohabit and interact within the same hexagonal cell? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK011 Are reduced-motion accessibility requirements (`prefers-reduced-motion`) specified for animated interaction arcs and event pulses? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK012 Are internationalization (`i18n`) parity requirements across all 8 supported locales (`en`, `es`, `zh`, `fr`, `de`, `pt`, `ja`, `ru`) with English (`en`) as default specified for all new legend, hover card, and camera control labels? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007, §Assumptions]

## Notes

- All 12/12 requirement-quality criteria reviewed and verified against `spec.md`, `data-model.md`, and `contracts/visual-map.contract.md`.
